newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-NAPOLI SIGN ARGENTINE CALDERON FOR $4.5 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NAPOLI SIGN ARGENTINE CALDERON FOR $4.5 MILLION.

text.p: Italian serie A side Napoli have signed Argentine international striker Jose Luis Calderon from Independiente for next season, a Napoli spokesman told Reuters on Monday.
"We have reached an agreement with the Argentine club after three days of talks in Buenos Aires," the spokesman said.

Sources close to the club said the deal for Calderon, second top scorer in the Argentine league this season, was worth some $4.5 million. He becomes Napoli's first Argentine player since Diego Maradona.
Calderon will follow Independiente coach Cesar Luis Menotti to Italy. Menotti confirmed last week he would move to Sampdoria next season.
